name: Jean D. Rossi Cognetti

death.place: Paoli Hospital, Paoli, Chester County, Pennsylvania (residence Exton)

bioAdditions: Jean D. Rossi was born in Old Forge on 28 April 1932, the daughter of Santino (Sandy) Rossi and Elizabeth Marino Rossi. She married Leo S. Cognetti about 1954 and they were married 65 years. A homemaker and school librarian and a keen golfer, she died at Paoli Hospital on 27 April 2023, aged 90 (S1, S2).

name: Domenica 'Min' Cognetti

death.date: 2009 (about March, two months before her husband)

bioAdditions: Domenica, called 'Aunt Min' by the family, married Joseph F. Cognetti in 1946 after his Army Air Corps service. They founded the Cognetti family Thanksgiving in 1966, retired to Glenmaura in Moosic, and died two months apart in 2009 after 63 years of marriage. Her maiden name has not been found (S1, S2).

relationships.evidence: Joseph's obituary and the 2016 Thanksgiving article
